title: Flesher and Weekly v. Metro Atlanta Presbytery
disposition_detail: Complaint 2015-03 declared moot because its issues were adjudicated in Appeal 2015-08; no merits ruling or relief on the complaint. The SJC approved the decision by recorded vote.
first_summary: Complaint 2015-03 by Steve Flesher and Randy Weekly against Metro Atlanta Presbytery was dismissed by the SJC. The decision states that because the issues had been adjudicated in Appeal 2015-08, the complaint was moot, and the SJC approved the decision. No merits reasoning or underlying facts are supplied.
summary: In Complaint 2015-03, Steve Flesher and Randy Weekly challenged Metro Atlanta Presbytery, but the SJC did not reach the merits. Because the issues raised had already been adjudicated in Appeal 2015-08, the SJC declared Complaint 2015-03 moot and approved that disposition. The short decision thus records a mootness ruling based on prior appellate adjudication; the underlying presbytery action and the Appeal 2015-08 decision are not described in the supplied text.
